messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法提供紐約市的即時交通資訊。建議您使用 Google Maps、Apple Maps 或其他交通監控服務（如 Waze、Citymapper 等）來查看最新的交通狀況。這些平台通常會顯示道路擁堵程度、事故報告以及最佳行車路線。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to provide traffic info. We can use the geocode_address function to get location coordinates for New York. But we need traffic data. The function only geocodes addresses. There's no function to get traffic. So we cannot provide real-time traffic. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can suggest using Google Maps or other services. We can also provide general info about typical traffic patterns. But we can't give current traffic. So we should respond accordingly.
